en-GB.name: Our Library
en-GB.summary: Listen to titles from your personal Audiobookshelf server.
en-GB.description:
Stream from your self-hosted Audiobookshelf server on any Alexa device. Say "Alexa, open Our Library" and then "play The Lord of the Rings" or "continue" to resume where you left off.

Requires a self-hosted Audiobookshelf instance reachable over HTTPS from the public internet and an API key. Configure ABS_BASE_URL and ABS_API_KEY as Lambda environment variables.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Our Library to continue
Alexa, ask Our Library to play The Hobbit
